scope: Read-only actual-photo continuity review of selected v3 frames008→014 after producing009–013.
review_method: Viewed each selected full-resolution photograph in chronological order; approximate landmarks are human visual estimates, not segmentation, mocap or numerical validation of gait.
individual_frame_result: All five selected photographs contain four readable connected limbs and differ in actual paw/body pose. No clear inverted hock, fused paw, added limb or repeated identical silhouette was seen.
continuity_result: Improved phase variety over v2, but a consistently natural continuous gallop is not verified and still has visibly discontinuous forepaw and head/body transitions.

observations: Bent forepaws remain beneath chest rather than suddenly reaching fully left.
Hindlegs open/down and body lengthens/lowers. Muzzle ~430→445 remains close.
Far forepaw advances left roughly280px and near forepaw155px in one slot; hind legs open rearward.
Head drops roughly30px. Distinct phase change is evident but the foot arc is abrupt.
Forepaws move right/up by roughly30–55px/20–25px, reversing preceding leftward reach.
Hind limb stagger changes substantially; muzzle rises roughly40–45px.
Muzzle/back descend roughly45–50px, larger than nearby guide variation.
Near hindsole approaches850; pre-contact gap is ambiguous. Far hindpaw remains raised.
Far hindpaw descends roughly30–40px and the more curled forepaw opens left70–90px.
Torso/head silhouette is similar; near hindsole stays ~850. This pair cannot establish exact landing timing.
Both hind soles reach the floor, with bent knees/hocks and depressed pelvis.
Forepaws reach left/up another roughly90–140px; head height differs about20px.

prioritized_remaining_repairs: 009→010 foreleg uncurling still spans a large foot displacement; an intermediate curved-elbow trajectory would need actual photographic verification.
010→011→012 head/back rise then fall and forepaw arc reversal remain; image-generation guide compliance is approximate rather than a physical animation guarantee.
limitations: Imagegen output scale/pose does not exactly reproduce guide coordinates. Four limbs, distinct poses, hashes and byte identity verify limited properties only; they do not prove a natural animated cycle. No pixel postprocessing, no prior full-body photo used as a generation reference for009–013.
